title: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation
meta_description: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation services from Dataq Software: scope, delivery pattern, platforms and committed outcomes.

blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation turns knowledge work into orchestrated autonomy. We build goal-directed, tool-using agents that operate inside your systems and controls, wire them into human-in-the-loop checkpoints where regulation demands it, and instrument every decision path for replay. The tower spans process and task mining, decision intelligence, intelligent document processing, and the integration spine that lets hundreds of automations run as one governed fleet.

The economics flipped: agent runtimes, evaluation suites, and orchestration frameworks are production-grade, while labor costs and error costs keep rising. Boards no longer ask whether to automate — they ask why exception rates are still above 30% and why month-end close still takes nine days when the work is pattern-shaped.
What goes live, and in what order
Agentic AI & Hyperautomation decomposes into named services, each with its own page:

items: Agentic Process Automation
Agents that execute the work — tool-using, policy-bounded, and replayable for audit.
Digital Workforce & Multi-Agent Orchestration
Hundreds of agents as one governed fleet — roles, queues, budgets and audit for the AI workforce.
Decision Intelligence Systems
Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — decision hubs with policy, evidence and replay built in.
Intelligent Document Processing
Contracts, claims and invoices read end-to-end — extraction, validation and downstream action.
Process & Task Mining
See the work as it actually runs — event-log truth before you automate anything.
Hyperautomation & Systems Integration
One automation spine — APIs, events, RPA and agents composable under common control.
Autonomous Workflow Orchestration
Self-healing workflows — long-running business processes that adapt, retry and recover without tickets.
